name: @projects/ast-grep-skill
description: Pinned ast-grep CLI for agent outline/search workflows (0.44.0+ for outline).

scripts.precommit: bun run precommit:rules && bun run precommit:semver
scripts.precommit:packages: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain packages --domain agents-ast-grep --fail-on
scripts.supply-chain:scan: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --zone agents
scripts.supply-chain:ci: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-ci --fail-on
scripts.supply-chain:pillars: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-pillars --threat-feed --format markdown
scripts.supply-chain:packages:pillars: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain packages --profile pillars --path .
scripts.supply-chain:color: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-pillars --threat-feed --color
scripts.supply-chain:ansi: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-pillars --threat-feed --format ansi
scripts.supply-chain:plaintext: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-pillars --threat-feed --format plaintext
scripts.supply-chain:packages:md: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain packages --profile pillars --path . --format markdown
scripts.supply-chain:network: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-network --path .agents/skills/ast-grep/scripts --format markdown
scripts.supply-chain:network:dist: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist --format markdown
scripts.supply-chain:network:loop: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --health-url http://localhost:3000 --loop --watch
scripts.supply-chain:network:loop:herdr: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --loop --watch --herdr-tab --domain sports-terminal-os
scripts.supply-chain:network:dry-run: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --domain sports-terminal-os --dry-run --verbose
scripts.supply-chain:network:seed: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --domain sports-terminal-os --seed
scripts.supply-chain:network:validate: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain network --validate-ground-truth --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --domain sports-terminal-os
scripts.supply-chain:snapshot:capture:net: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain snapshot capture --path projects/active/sports-terminal-os --network-path projects/active/sports-terminal-os/dist/frontend --domain sports-terminal-os --out .agents/skills/ast-grep/baselines/sports-terminal-os/snapshot.json
scripts.supply-chain:platform: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain platform list
scripts.supply-chain:cross-linux: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain scan --profile supply-chain-cross-linux-x64 --zone agents --no-color
scripts.supply-chain:packages: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun supply-chain packages --domain agents-ast-grep
scripts.bun:heatmap: bun scripts/bun-cli.ts bun heatmap --zone sports-terminal --tier core
